notes:
- **Skip the filler.** Anime episodes are now marked as **Filler**, **Mixed**
  (part story, part filler) or **Anime canon** (story the anime added), so you
  can see at a glance which ones you can skip. Episodes that follow the manga
  carry no mark.
- **Choose your way to watch.** A show that has filler gets a **Way to watch**
  card on its page: **Every episode**, **No filler**, **Canon only** or
  **Manga canon only**. Your choice is saved for you alone, per show.
- **Play, Next and Up next follow your choice.** Play picks up at the next
  episode you want, Next and Previous step over the skipped ones (the Up next
  card says what it skips, like "Skips 57–71 · filler"), and **Next Up** on
  Home does the same. Skipped episodes are dimmed on the show's page but still
  play when you click them, and an episode you're halfway through always
  resumes.
